items.title: Bob W makes energy a KPI for managers as it secures B Corp status
items.summary: # Bob W makes energy a KPI for managers as it secures B Corp status Hospitality company Bob W has made energy efficiency a performance KPI for every general manager as part of its efforts to reduce emissions, which are now 69% below the European hotel average.

items.title: Welsh Commissioner calls for halt on new AI data centres over environmental concerns
items.summary: # Welsh Commissioner calls for halt on new AI data centres over environmental concerns The Future Generations Commissioner for Wales has called for a pause on approvals for new artificial intelligence (AI) data centres until national guidance is introduced to address their impact on water, energy, the environment and local communities.

items.title: Media reaction: Who is to blame for COP31 ‘failure’?
items.summary: COP31 came to a dramatic close last weekend when a coalition of nations rejected the proposed “Antalya pact”, citing its failure to mention fossil fuels.
